nom: belif Super Drops Niacinamide and Vitamin C Golden Glow Serum

avis.texte: I LOVE Belif products from their cleanser, sunscreen, eye cream, moisturizer etc. I decided to try this. It made my face tingle for a few minutes. Later thay day my entire face broke out in white heads. I rarely breakout. Ive tried this product about 4 times & days apart. Each time the same thing has happened. This one is going in the trash for me. Its a not for me. 😭
I love the subtle glow of this, goes on smoothly, and looks great under makeup.

avis.titre: This is pretty over a cc Cream, or bare skin
avis.texte: I first tried this as a sample.. it is so pretty! I like it over a cc Cream. It gives a luminous glow, tiny sparkle. I have a pale, pale olive complexion, this does NOT look orange. I dislike that fake bronzer, dirty look, this doesn't do that, it is a beautiful addition

I don't use this product every day. I have other exfoliating and vitamin c serums. I do, however, really love the way this works under makeup. It does help blur pores, and enhances glow. It doesn't take much, and you can over do it. Overall nice product, though.

Makes me break out only when i use it so ive has this sijce September gave the benefit the doubt and sure enough every time i put on it breaks me out in small white bumps and im not by all means a break out person i wanted to lovevthis but i an going to throw away after mybuse yesterday i hage white bumps everywhere!
Read the ingredients yourself. Not enough niacinimide and ascorbic acid to notice a difference

I have gone through 4 bottles of this now and that never happens for me. I am a person that is constantly trying all the new releases and never return to any one product, rarely. This is perfection in a bottle. I wear this nonstop for my no makeup days. It gives my skin a gorgeous glow without looking like the tin man and also keeps it hydrated. If you're looking for something to hydrate, give you a subtle glow that you can wear alone or under makeup, this is it. I rave about this to everyone who mentions wanting to start on their skincare journey but doesn't want to start with 5 steps. If you use just one product every morning, let it be this. I have very sensitive, dry skin and this has never irritated or failed to keep my face hydrated. The only way this could be improved is if they made a version with SPF in it.

I have noticed a huge difference in my pores and skin texture using this product daily for a year. it's beautiful pearls give me a healthy glow but also works well under my make-up. I go through a bottle every month.
It wasn't until I was hosting a booth at a conference and two young interns commented that my skin was glowing that I should have this for every day. I'm in my 40s and that made my day brighter.

This serum is thicker than most vitamin C serums because it contains skin-mimicking lipids designed to imitate the natural lipids in the skin barrier. These lipids help seal in moisture and give the serum an almost oil-like, occlusive feel. It's nice, but not ideal if you plan on layering other serums or prefer your vitamin C to go on first. This serum is so thick that it really needs to be applied last, right before moisturizer or SPF. It's sticky—I have to double cleanse my hands just to remove the residue after application. If you prefer a thinner texture, I'd recommend their vitamin C drops instead. My mistake, but it still feels too tacky for my taste. That said, it does leave the skin looking glowy and blurred and doesn't irritate at all. Overall, it's just too thick and sticky for me.
This makes my skin feel so soft and smooth and is an amazing base for makeup as well. Gives me a nice glow and works well with my sensitive, mature skin.

I got this from Ulta for my birthday present. I was not expecting much, but I was so pleasently surprized! This product is amazing. It feels so good on my skin, like REALLY good. The glow is amazing and it smells really good. I think this is now in my favorite product list. I plan to try more of their products soon because of the quality of this one.

Inlove with this product! It makes my skin glow instantly, while adding great moisture. Its not an ashy glow that would dull your skin, rsther a golden sun kissed glow. Its light, but noticeably better.
As an aging woman this is one of my favorites. I use it everyday, and it feels so nice.

I got a tester/sample size in an advent calendar and am pleasantly surprised! Not something i would normally buy but i do like it. The reviews saying its too thick, doesnt absorb well, i guarantee youre using way too much. It doesnt take much at all. Tad expensive.

avis.titre: More like makeup, less like skincare
avis.texte: This product is more of a makeup/skin care hybrid product than it is just makeup. It is very shimmery. However, if you are looking for a glowy makeup primer this would work. Would not recommend to wear this without makeup maybe under a skin tint or a light foundation.

I would not consider this a serum, and it's not the consistency of drops. This is a very thick formula that doesn't spread or absorb easily. I haven't noticed any difference to my skin. I'm glad I got it half off, won't be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Got it on a whim and now it's my favorite
avis.texte: I adore this cream! The way it leaves my skin feeling smooth and also with a beautiful glow. I got this on sale in a whim to try one day and now it will become a must have at all times! It serves as just a stand alone cream to wear with no makeup, but also as a nice primer under makeup.

avis.titre: obsessed with this and other belif products
avis.texte: I'm very sensitive so it was a joy to discover this one suits me so well. I had bad reactions to other vitamin C products, but all the belif ones have been awesome. I've used it every morning for several weeks and I like the results. Very subtle glowy effect. I love the scent of their products, too.
I love the idea of this product, but it made my skin super oily. If you have super oily to combination skin..I would not recommend this product.

avis.titre: 100% would buy this every time I run out.
avis.texte: I received this product as a gift and a very small trial size a little bit goes such a long way I was able to use it at least a good 2 to 3 weeks. I love the way it feels on my face. I used it every night, went back and purchased a larger bottle I have very mature skin
I bought this when it was half off, and I have really enjoyed it. It adds a glow and pairs well under makeup. I would buy it again but only on sale.

I bought this during the 21 days of beauty event. I absolutely love this! instantly made my skin radiant. after a month of Use, skin feels super soft and complexion is even and brighter. this is great for aging skin to bring life back into your complexion.

avis.titre: This is just a glittery serum…
avis.texte: I wish i could post a photo or a viceo. The "glow" is just glittery….. i look like a clown. Would never wear this alone. Might be good for a party or a beach day…
I just got this product and use it a few times so far i love it. Feels great on ur skin!!!

avis.titre: It's fine but not a repeat for me
avis.texte: Have pale, redness prone skin and am in my 50's and feel I need a lot of this serum. It's fine but I can't say I've seen any improvements with regular usage. With all the powerhouse serums out there, this won't be a repeat for me.

avis.titre: Gives a natural glow to my skin
avis.texte: First time trying this and I am very pleased with the results, it provides an enhanced glow and I would recommend this to others who want to try.
Got in my allure beauty box & purchasing full size! Took with me on my spring break trip & gave me the perfect sun kissed glow when layered under my sunscreen! Received many compliments!

I've tried multiple products to increase my "glow" and unfortunately, this product misses the mark for what I am looking for. It is a nice serum and dint irritate my sensitive skin. But if you expect a significant radiance from use, this isn't the product
